data.title: Bitcoin and ethereum prices today, Thursday, July 30, 2026: Prices rise after Fed leaves rates unchanged
data.description: Bitcoin opened at $63,902.90 on Thursday, July 30, 2026, flat compared to Wednesday's opening price. As of 9:00 a.m. ET, bitcoin moved up to $64,838.92. Ethereum opened at $1,908.34 on Thursday, July 30, 2026, down 0.6% from Wednesday's opening price. Ethereum moved higher to $1,923.23 as of 9:00 a.m. ET.
